gloss: beware of fire; fire safety; fire prevention

definitions.gloss: beware of fire; fire safety; fire prevention
definitions.explanation: A warning phrase about fire safety. Most commonly heard as a call during traditional neighborhood fire-watch patrols, where volunteers walk through residential areas at night, clapping wooden blocks and calling out this phrase.

examples.japanese: 「{火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}！」と{声|こえ}が{聞|き}こえた。
examples.english: I heard a voice calling "Beware of fire!"

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}になると、{火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}の{見回|みまわ}りがある。
examples.english: In winter, there are fire-watch patrols.

examples.japanese: {拍子木|ひょうしぎ}を{打|う}ちながら「{火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}、マッチ{一本|いっぽん}{火事|かじ}のもと」と{呼|よ}びかけた。
examples.english: He called out "Beware of fire — a single match can start a blaze" while clapping wooden clappers.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A phrase deeply embedded in Japanese culture. During the dry winter months, neighborhood volunteers ({夜回|よまわ}り) walk through residential streets at night, clapping {拍子木|ひょうしぎ} (wooden clappers) and calling out {火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}. The full traditional call is often: {火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}、マッチ{一本|いっぽん}{火事|かじ}のもと (Beware of fire — a single match can start a blaze).

USAGE:
Also seen on signs and posters as a general fire-safety warning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}の{見回|みまわ}り (fire-watch patrol)
- {火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}のポスター (fire-safety poster)
